data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Banti is the goddess of pleasure and sensuality. She is often depicted as a beautiful, voluptuous woman who grants desires related to pleasure and happiness. Banti is also known as Rati, the wife of the god of love, Kamadeva. The name Banti carries the meaning “Goddess of Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Banti usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
